notes: Five texture-only face variants with exactly one centred 56x46 mm QF Express label; orange 15 mm corner and lower-half barcode. Real hollow 3 mm shell, compressed corners, flap gap, exposed flutes and 48 mm tape folded 30 mm on both X ends. Fine tape wrinkles and shallow air bubbles are colour details; label and tape gloss use roughness maps. The single nominal solid-box collider intentionally ignores the sealed interior. Metres, Z up, front -X; applied transforms and shared bottom-centre origin. 64-sample CPU Cycles colour multiplied by mix(1, AO, 0.6), RGB8 sRGB. PBR source retains separate roughness, fine grain and edge wear. Instance color multiplier 0.97-1.03. 1024 px review renders retained in tools/blender/_qa/task17; mandatory compactor delivers 512 px previews. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification.
